articles.title: Squid Intents Launches Multi-Chain Swaps for Canton
articles.description: Squid Intents is now live on Canton, adding routes from supported assets on 30 chains, new liquidity for CC swaps and integration tools for wallets and applications.

articles.title: Ones Unveils Canton Business Account and Confirms MVP Is Ready
articles.description: Ones has introduced a financial platform for individuals, businesses and AI agents. Its business account is being built on Canton and is designed to bring payments, cards, payroll, invoicing, treasury and team management into one place.

articles.title: TreasurySpring’s $4 Billion Canton Plan Enters Governance Vote
articles.description: TreasurySpring’s Super Validator proposal has entered formal Canton voting. It begins with a $10 million Fixed Term Fund target and lays out a proposed path to $4 billion outstanding on Canton within 12 months of approval.

articles.title: Hashrupt Presents Six Verity Products on Canton
articles.description: Hashrupt has presented six products built around Verity, its shared platform on Canton. They cover lending, treasury, invoicing, project work and fundraising, with additional Settla and Backr features still in development.

articles.title: FTP Tech Resubmits Featured App Application for Canton x402 Payments
articles.description: FTP Tech has resubmitted its Featured App application for x402 tools on Canton. The service lets AI agents pay for individual online requests from their own wallets using Canton Coin or USDCx.

articles.title: Digital Asset CEO Confirms September CIP Draft for Network-Wide CC Burning
articles.description: Digital Asset CEO Yuval Rooz has confirmed that the Canton Improvement Proposal extending CC burning and validator rewards to every synchronizer on the Canton Network remains on track for submission this month, following earlier remarks from co-founder Shaul Kfir outlining the plan.

articles.title: Digital Asset Releases Canton 3.5.16 With Reliability Improvements
articles.description: Canton 3.5.16 is now available with reliability fixes, stronger timestamp validation, lower memory use during one internal process and expanded API documentation.

articles.title: Fireblocks Maps Out Institutional Collateral Workflows on Canton
articles.description: Fireblocks has published a practical guide to the Canton tools it supports for institutional collateral workflows, covering custody, wallets, validator options, contract calls, transaction approvals and reporting.

articles.title: South Korea Sets Roadmap for Tokenized Stocks, Bonds and Funds
articles.description: South Korea will begin the first phase of its tokenized securities roadmap in February 2027. The plan starts with institutional funds and bonds, unlisted shares and fractional investments, with later phases planned for public securities and onchain settlement.

articles.title: Tradecraft Reports More Than $3 Million in Canton TVL
articles.description: Tradecraft reports that the total value locked across its Canton liquidity pools has passed $3 million. The figure measures assets held in the pools that support trading on the platform.

articles.title: Rocky Wallet Plans Support for Hecto Assets on Canton
articles.description: Rocky plans to support Hecto ecosystem assets in Rocky Wallet and make the wallet available as a connection inside Hecto products. Technical details and release timing are still to come.

articles.title: Five North Launches Paid Plans for Lighthouse API
articles.description: Five North has introduced paid Lighthouse API plans alongside its continuing free tier. The new structure offers different levels of access for projects using Canton data.

articles.title: Alpend Completes Major Protocol Upgrade on Canton
articles.description: Alpend has upgraded its Canton money market with multiparty hosting, distributed protocol controls and a Halborn-audited codebase. The upgrade also raises supply caps and introduces Ascent 2 rewards for migrated positions.

articles.title: eesee Outlines Plans for a Connected Financial Hub on Canton
articles.description: eesee has outlined plans to connect its launchpad with portfolio tracking and vaults on Canton. The company reports 91 launches and more than $10.9 million raised through its existing launchpad.

articles.title: Canton Development Fund Pays 9.37 Million CC Across Eight Milestones
articles.description: The Canton Development Fund has paid 9,368,809 CC across eight completed milestones covering application rewards, token support, wallet infrastructure, testing, developer tools and governance.

articles.title: Canton Approves 15 Validator Operators as 25 More Enter Review
articles.description: Fifteen organizations can now begin deploying Canton validator infrastructure, while a new group of 25 applicants enters community review. MainNet access still requires a separate allocation.

articles.title: DSRV Brings Canton Into ITCEN Group’s Live Cafe Payment System
articles.description: South Korean infrastructure provider DSRV has moved ITCEN Group’s Cafe de CEN ordering and payment service onto Canton, connecting it with the group’s ERP for real-time order, payment and settlement processing.

articles.title: Canton Loop Opens TestNet Trial for New Transaction Fee Model
articles.description: Canton Loop has opened limited TestNet access to a new fee model that shows users the network cost before they approve a transaction.

articles.title: Temple Digital Group and HIFI Partner to Enable Direct Bank-to-Canton Funding and Settlement
articles.description: Temple Digital Group and HIFI have partnered to enable direct bank-to-Canton funding and withdrawal, allowing Temple users to deposit US dollars, trade on Canton, and withdraw back to their bank account 24/7 through HIFI's stablecoin conversion infrastructure.

articles.title: HashKey Joins DTCC Tokenization Working Group as First Asian Digital Asset Provider
articles.description: HashKey Group has joined DTCC's tokenization working group as its first Asian digital asset provider, ahead of DTCC's planned October 2026 commercial service launch on Canton Network and Hyperledger Besu infrastructure.

articles.title: Sync Insights Launches Unified Workspace for Analytics, Monitoring, and Automation on Canton Network
articles.description: Sync Insights has launched a unified workspace for Canton Network combining analytics, automated workflows, governance visibility, private transfer insights, and transaction parsing, building on a platform that has delivered more than 800,000 insights since June 2025.

articles.title: French crypto platform Coinhouse adds Canton Coin
articles.description: French crypto platform Coinhouse has added Canton Coin, allowing customers to buy CC with euros, then hold, sell or exchange it within their Coinhouse accounts.

articles.title: arCCade confirms Canton Featured App Status as early access nears
articles.description: arCCade has confirmed its Featured App status on Canton Network as it prepares to welcome its first users. The waitlist is open, with the first access codes due to be distributed soon.

articles.title: FinTech Magazine Names Digital Asset Among Its Top 10 Digital Asset Platforms
articles.description: Digital Asset has been included in FinTech Magazine’s Top 10 Digital Asset Platforms, with Daml and Canton highlighted as central parts of the company’s work.

articles.title: DTCC Tokenization Service Set for October Commercial Launch After July Production Trades
articles.description: DTCC's tokenization service is set for commercial launch in October 2026 following successful July production trades on Canton Network, with more than 50 institutions including BlackRock, JPMorgan, and Goldman Sachs participating in the Industry Working Group.

articles.title: Hanwha Plans Its First Tokenized Product on Canton
articles.description: Hanwha Investment & Securities is preparing a Canton-based product issuance as it develops a digital-asset platform initially aimed at professional investors.

articles.title: OKJ Launches Canton Coin Quiz With 70,000 CC in Rewards
articles.description: OKJ has opened a ten-question Canton Coin quiz running until September 18. Participants who answer at least seven questions correctly can share 60,000 CC, with another 10,000 CC reserved for ten selected qualifiers.

articles.title: BitSafe’s CBTC Goes Live on Swap Monster Across Four Canton Markets
articles.description: BitSafe’s CBTC is now available on Swap Monster against CC, USDCx, EDELx and TRAKXRWA. The venue lets eligible institutional participants trade through private quotes while keeping assets in their wallets until a price is accepted.

articles.title: ZeroVaultID Activates Validator on Canton MainNet
articles.description: ZeroVaultID has activated its Canton MainNet validator. It is now seeking a partner for the first MainNet deployment of its privacy-focused compliance tools.

articles.title: Virtu Financial, M1X Global, and Tradeweb Complete First Fully On-Chain Repo Using Sovereign Digital Bond on Canton Network
articles.description: Virtu Financial, M1X Global, and Tradeweb have completed the first fully on-chain repo using a natively issued sovereign digital bond as collateral on Canton Network, settling the full cycle atomically in under 10 minutes without prime broker intermediation.

articles.title: Cantex Trading Volume Passes $200 Million
articles.description: Cantex has reported more than $200 million in cumulative trading volume, just over eight days after announcing its $150 million milestone. The update follows the launch of Cantex Connect, which lets compatible Canton wallets trade without opening the platform’s interface.

articles.title: Canton Foundation Development Fund adopts rules for AI assisted proposals
articles.description: A new policy sets out how contributors can use AI for Development Fund work, including funding proposals, code and milestone submissions.

articles.title: Circle's USYC seeks Canton Featured App Status
articles.description: Circle's USYC has applied for Featured App status on Canton, with Digital Asset as sponsor. The tokenized money-market fund is already live on the network.

articles.title: OneSwap goes live inside Slay Money
articles.description: Slay Money users can now swap Canton assets inside the app through its OneSwap integration, without opening another tab or reconnecting their wallet.

articles.title: HANDL adds EDEL transfers between Base and Canton
articles.description: HANDL users can now move EDEL between Base and Canton inside the app. The bridge expands the existing options to receive, hold and swap Edel's token on Canton.

articles.title: mperps Introduces Canton Perpetual Trading With Aster
articles.description: mperps has introduced perpetual trading with Aster, with account balances recorded on Canton. Access requires an invitation code, while Hyperliquid and Lighter are planned additions.

articles.title: Canton Foundation Publishes Development Fund Roadmap Through 2028
articles.description: The Canton Foundation has outlined 28 areas for development funding, including simpler account hosting, better tools for builders and stronger security. The roadmap also sets growth targets for 2028.

articles.title: Canton Development Fund Approves Up to 1.61 Million CC for Hacken and BootNode
articles.description: Hacken and BootNode have received approval for Development Fund grants totaling up to 1.61 million CC. The funding supports security monitoring and tools for Canton developers, with payments tied to milestones.

articles.title: Digital Asset Details Canton's Post-Quantum Security Plans
articles.description: Canton plans to introduce security methods designed to resist future quantum-computer attacks over the next six to twelve months. Partners are already testing an experimental digital-signature option.

articles.title: Sixteen Validator Applications Open for Canton Review
articles.description: Sixteen organizations have applied to operate Canton validators, with community review open until September 2. Their plans include wallets, tokenized assets and services for financial institutions.

articles.title: Alpend Integrates Temple for Collateral Management on Canton
articles.description: Alpend has integrated Temple's trading system into its early-access lending market. The connection will support collateral sales during liquidations, with the aim of improving recoveries.

articles.title: Edel Markets Moves Toward Public Beta
articles.description: Edel Finance is preparing to bring Edel Markets into public beta through Supanova, giving the new Canton venue access to an app that reports 80,000 users.

articles.title: HANDL Opens Founders Circle While Work on 2.0 Continues
articles.description: HANDL has created a private group for long-term holders, builders and power users who want to work more closely with the team.

articles.title: Hecto Reveals Its Next Three Products on Canton
articles.description: Hecto has set out its next three product routes, with Predictions V2, PMX and Vaults built for different parts of the private-market audience.

articles.title: Canborsa Enables Canton Coin as Collateral, Deepening Its Canton Network Integration
articles.description: Canborsa now supports Canton Coin as collateral for perpetual trading, allowing users to trade CC/USDCx with up to 5x leverage. The update expands Canton Coin utility in the Canton ecosystem with new trading rewards and quests.

articles.title: IntellectEU and Noves Integrate Private Data Layer Into CatalyX, Closing a Key Gap for Institutional Canton Deployments
articles.description: IntellectEU has integrated the Noves Data Platform into CatalyX Blockchain Manager, bringing private financial and operational data infrastructure into a single production environment for more than 100 active Canton validators.

articles.title: Temple Approved for DvP Treatment on Canton
articles.description: Temple has received approval for DvP treatment on Canton. The decision covers qualifying trades where the asset and payment settle together in a single transaction.

articles.title: World Liberty Financial Launches USD1 Directly on Canton Network
articles.description: World Liberty Financial’s USD1 stablecoin is now issued directly on Canton Network. Institutions can configure it as the dollar payment for tokenized assets, allowing the asset and payment to settle together.

articles.title: Cantex Launches Cantex Connect, Bringing Wallet-Agnostic Trading to Its Exchange
articles.description: Cantex has introduced Cantex Connect, allowing any wallet in the Canton ecosystem that supports a transfer memo to trade on Cantex through a native token transfer, with no permissioned integration, browser extension, or SDK required.

articles.title: Console Wallet Launches First Visa Card on Canton Network, Allowing Direct Spending of Canton Coin
articles.description: Console Wallet has launched the first Visa card on Canton Network following successful initial testing, allowing users to spend Canton Coin directly at any card-accepting merchant through Apple Pay or Google Pay.

articles.title: Cenote Moves Under Kintsu as Canton Credit Platform Becomes Kintsu Capital Markets
articles.description: Kintsu is bringing Cenote’s Canton-focused credit work into its wider platform. The Cenote brand will retire, while the product under development continues as Kintsu Capital Markets.

articles.title: Vanguard and Wellington Test Tokenized Collateral on Canton
articles.description: Vanguard and Wellington Management have completed their first tokenized collateral test trades on Canton. Nasdaq Calypso managed the process around each trade, while the collateral moved and settled on Canton.

articles.title: Alpend Completes Smart Contract Audit With Halborn Security
articles.description: Alpend has completed a smart contract audit with Halborn Security, with all findings resolved ahead of the credit protocol's planned deployment on Canton Network.

articles.title: R1M Seeks Canton Featured App Status for Sentinel
articles.description: R1M has applied for Canton Featured App status for R1M Sentinel, its validator-monitoring service. The team plans to introduce premium subscriptions paid in Canton Coin in early September.

articles.title: Canton Development Fund Allocates More Than 162 Million CC Across 32 Proposals
articles.description: Canton’s Development Fund has allocated more than 162 million CC across 32 approved proposals supporting protocol development, infrastructure, security and ecosystem tools. Funding is released as teams complete and pass their agreed milestones.

articles.title: Canton Network Welcomes 10 New Validator Applicants Spanning Finance, Agriculture, AI, and Retail
articles.description: The Canton Foundation has published its latest batch of validator operator submissions, covering 10 applicants ranging from AI agent payment platforms to RWA issuers and luxury retail, with a one-week window for concerns before implicit approval on August 26, 2026.

articles.title: Canton Clarifies Featured App Rewards for Multi-Asset Transactions
articles.description: Canton’s Tokenomics Committee has clarified how Featured App reward weight is calculated when a transaction includes more than one Featured Asset. Ordinary transactions share the available weight across those assets, while approved delivery-versus-payment venues use a separate calculation when both sides of an exchange settle together.

articles.title: Canton Coin Goes Live on Bitstamp by Robinhood With USD and EUR Markets
articles.description: Canton Coin is now available on Bitstamp by Robinhood, with CC/USD and CC/EUR spot markets open for trading. Bitstamp’s public data also shows Canton Network deposits and withdrawals are enabled, subject to regional access.

articles.title: HSBC CST Receives Featured App Status on Canton TestNet
articles.description: HSBC CST has received Featured App status on Canton Network’s TestNet after all 13 Super Validators supported the proposal. The right became active on August 21, adding another milestone to HSBC’s work across the network.

articles.title: Digital Asset and American Idea Foundation Pilot Blockchain-Based Benefit Distribution on Canton Network
articles.description: Digital Asset and the American Idea Foundation have announced a collaboration to pilot blockchain-based government benefit distribution using Canton Network, testing a unified, programmable system for delivering state RISE benefits to families across multiple assistance programs.

articles.title: Canton Foundation Launches Super Validator Operations Calendar
articles.description: The Canton Foundation has launched a web-based master calendar for Super Validator operations, giving operators and app providers a clearer view of upgrades, dependencies and planned network events.

articles.title: Canton Approves 17 Validator Operators and Issues New MainNet Allocations
articles.description: Canton’s latest governance updates approve 17 validator operators, while a separate MainNet allocation notice expands access across 22 organizations and 26 allocation entries.

articles.title: Canton Enables CIP-0104 Models and Featured App Weight Voting
articles.description: Canton has enabled CIP-0104’s supporting Daml models and Featured App weight-voting interface on MainNet, advancing the network’s move toward traffic-based app rewards.

articles.title: CAC Launches Pactora With Canton Network Support
articles.description: Japanese technology company CAC has launched Pactora, a multichain platform for issuing, managing and settling tokenized assets across Canton Network, Avalanche and Solana.

articles.title: Canton Coin Now Available on Ledger, Bringing Institutional-Grade Asset to Retail Hardware Wallets
articles.description: Canton Coin is now available natively on Ledger hardware wallets, opening CC self-custody to individual holders for the first time as the token moves beyond its institutional and validator roots.

articles.title: Temple Trading Data Goes Live on Token Terminal
articles.description: Temple Digital Group’s market data is now available across Token Terminal, giving users access to trading activity from the Canton-based platform.

articles.title: Interstice Digital Launches Cross-Chain Swap Engine Connecting Canton Network to Robinhood Chain, Solana, and Ethereum
articles.description: Interstice Digital and FalconX have launched a non-custodial cross-chain swap engine connecting Canton Network to Robinhood Chain, Solana, and Ethereum, named a Featured App on Canton as institutional and retail liquidity paths converge on the network.

articles.title: ChainSafe Launches x402 Facilitator for Native Data Monetization on Canton Network
articles.description: ChainSafe has released the x402 Facilitator, open source infrastructure that brings account-free HTTP 402 micro-billing to Canton Network, enabling autonomous AI agents to discover, query, and pay for enterprise data in real time.

articles.title: Canton Coin Lists on SolCex
articles.description: SolCex, the first centralized exchange launched on Solana, has listed Canton Coin (CC), giving traders a new venue to trade CC on the platform.

articles.title: Franklin Templeton Clears First Canton Treasury-Management Milestone
articles.description: Canton’s Tokenomics Working Group has approved Franklin Templeton’s first CIP-0118 milestone as complete and approved it for the release of one unit of Super Validator weight.

articles.title: HackCanton Season 3 Opens Registration for Five-Week Online Builder Competition
articles.description: HackCanton Season 3 begins September 10 and runs online for five weeks, with workshops, mentoring and a live Grand Final. Registration is open to solo builders and teams, with up to $50,000 in cash and credits listed for the event.

articles.title: Console Wallet Integrates LetsExchange API to Expand Canton Coin Swaps
articles.description: Console Wallet has integrated the LetsExchange API, allowing Canton Coin holders to swap directly into stablecoins and EVM assets and fund their wallets from external networks, all within a single interface.

articles.title: Temple Goes Live on Token Terminal as Canton Network's Top Revenue Application
articles.description: Temple Digital Group has listed on Token Terminal, making Canton Network's highest revenue-generating application publicly trackable on a major analytics platform for the first time.

articles.title: Splice 0.7.2 Adds Session Key Support and Updates SV Voting
articles.description: Splice 0.7.2 moves to Canton 3.5.13, adds official session signing key support for KMS enabled validator and Super Validator participants, and updates how SV votes are handled while requests remain open.

articles.title: Cantor8 Announces Taran Route to Gold, Silver and T-Bills on Canton
articles.description: Cantor8 has announced that merchants using Taran App can exchange tokenized mobile money for gold, silver and Treasury-bill products on Canton through C8 Wallet.

articles.title: Canton Strategic Reports $1.5 Million in Second-Quarter Revenue
articles.description: Canton Strategic Holdings reported $1.5 million in second-quarter revenue, including $191,226 from network validation and $1.3 million in other revenue, primarily from locking-as-a-service agreements.

articles.title: Digital Asset Releases Canton 3.5.13 With CantonBFT and Traffic Enforcement Improvements
articles.description: Digital Asset has released Canton 3.5.13, a maintenance update focused on CantonBFT and traffic enforcement. It refines how nodes retrieve missing batches during connectivity issues and adds new optional controls for participant operators.

articles.title: Cancore’s USDCx–USDC Route Goes Live Between Canton and Ethereum
articles.description: Cancore has made a route for USDCx on Canton and USDC on Ethereum available through an atomic settlement flow that it says keeps assets with counterparties until settlement completes.

articles.title: OneSwap Launches First 'Pump.fun-Style' Token Launchpad on Canton Network
articles.description: OneSwap has announced the first Pump.fun-like token launchpad built on Canton Network, letting users create, add liquidity to, and trade tokens in minutes, with the platform going live soon.

articles.title: Ember Treasury Is Live on Canton, With Trading on Cantex
articles.description: Ember Protocol has introduced Ember Treasury (USTY), which it describes as tokenized U.S. Treasury bills for onchain markets. Ember says USTY is live on Canton and available for trading on Cantex.

articles.title: Nuxaris: Private cross-chain bridge into Canton Network.
articles.description: Nuxaris is a Canton-native, non-custodial bridge that enables private, bidirectional transfers between Canton Coin and supported networks including Solana, Ethereum and Base. It combines multi-wallet support with a simple route into and out of the Canton ecosystem.

articles.title: MUFG, Digital Asset and Progmat Launch Canton JGB Repo Pilot
articles.description: MUFG and three group companies have joined Digital Asset and Progmat to launch a Canton proof of concept for Japanese government-bond repo transactions. It will explore simultaneous settlement of JGBs and digital money, together with a more automated repo lifecycle.

articles.title: CertiK Maps the Full Security Model Behind Canton Assets
articles.description: CertiK’s new guide explains how CIP-56 gives Canton assets a common interface, while implementation, client transaction construction and interpretation, and operational permissions collectively shape their security. The piece focuses on the security boundaries that institutions and developers should assess.

articles.title: Digital Asset CEO Says It Is Time for a Fuller Korea Entry
articles.description: In an original BusinessPost interview, Yuval Rooz said he believes it is an appropriate time for Digital Asset to enter Korea in earnest, with institutional Canton use a priority. He cited insurance as a possible use case and said further announcements could follow in the coming weeks.

articles.title: Digital Asset Releases Canton 2.10.6 to Improve Post-Migration Reconnects
articles.description: Canton 2.10.6 is a maintenance release that targets reconnect performance after hard domain migrations for PostgreSQL-based deployments with large active contract sets. It also updates dependencies to resolve Netty security issues.

articles.title: OpenZeppelin Opens Its Canton Development Stack to Public Review
articles.description: OpenZeppelin has made early Daml components and reference architectures for Canton public, including CIP-112 token and settlement tooling. The materials invite developer testing, feedback and further implementation work.

articles.title: Broadridge's Blockchain Repo Platform Processes $8 Trillion in July, Deepening Ties to Canton Network
articles.description: Broadridge Financial Solutions processed $8 trillion in repo transactions through its Distributed Ledger Repo platform in July, as the company continues to deepen its role in the Canton Network ecosystem, alongside a cross-border intraday repo transaction involving DTCC, Euroclear, Tradeweb, Citadel Securities, and Societe Generale settled on Canton.

articles.title: Rocky Exchange Wins HackCanton Season 2 as Umbra and Tirai Complete the Podium
articles.description: More than 360 builders from over 60 countries took part in HackCanton Season 2, with Rocky Exchange finishing first ahead of Umbra and Tirai.

articles.title: Canton Network Leads All Blockchains in 30-Day Fee Generation at $53.35 Million
articles.description: Canton Network has generated $53.35 million in fees over the past 30 days, ranking first among all blockchains globally ahead of Hyperliquid and Tron, according to DeFiLlama data.

articles.title: SBI Digital Practice and Nodeinfra Plan Japan-Korea Stablecoin Payment Network
articles.description: SBI Digital Practice and Nodeinfra plan to develop the Musubi Project, a cross-border payment and settlement network built on Canton, beginning with yen and won test tokens.

articles.title: Zenith Demonstrates Canton-EVM Atomic Swap on Test Network
articles.description: Zenith has demonstrated an atomic swap between a CIP-56 asset on Canton and an ERC-20 asset on Zenith as work continues toward EVM integration with Canton MainNet.

articles.title: ISLA Joins Canton Foundation as Associate Member to Shape Digital Securities Finance Standards
articles.description: ISLA has joined the Canton Foundation as an associate member, placing the securities finance industry's leading trade body inside Canton Network's collateral and technology working groups.

articles.title: Digital Asset Addresses 10 Common Canton Network Myths
articles.description: As the Canton Network continues to scale it has become a central point of conversation for institutions exploring digital assets. Because of its unique design - tailored for institutional finance - some misunderstandings regarding its architecture, governance, and openness have emerged. This article aims to address some common misconceptions, and clarify how the Canton Network functions, is governed, and delivers value to its global ecosystem.

articles.title: Nano Labs Approved as Canton Network Validator
articles.description: Nano Labs has been approved to operate a validator node on Canton, joining the network’s global validator ecosystem.

articles.title: PartyLayer Passes 106,000 npm Downloads and Announces Its New Roadmap
articles.description: The open source wallet connection layer for the Canton Network crosses a six figure adoption milestone and sets out its plan for the next twelve months.

articles.title: Temple Digital Group and RedStone Partner to Bring Pricing Infrastructure to Commodity Markets on Canton
articles.description: Temple Digital Group and RedStone have partnered to bring RedStone's institutional price feeds to Temple's newly launched gold and silver commodity markets on Canton Network.

articles.title: 1exchange Approved as Canton Validator for RWA Tokenization
articles.description: 1exchange has been approved as a Canton validator and plans to use the network’s privacy-preserving infrastructure for future RWA tokenization, listings and trading.

articles.title: BOOSTRY Plans Canton Multi-Chain Wallet With Digital Asset
articles.description: BOOSTRY and Digital Asset are working together on a corporate multi-chain wallet scheduled for launch by the end of 2026, beginning with support for Canton.

articles.title: FOMO Pay Receives Canton Validator Approval
articles.description: FOMO Pay has received validator approval on Canton and plans to use the network for institutional B2B payments and settlement.

articles.title: Franklin Templeton Becomes a Canton Super Validator
articles.description: Franklin Templeton Digital Assets has announced its new role as a Super Validator on Canton Network, expanding its involvement from tokenized fund deployment into network infrastructure. Its potential Super Validator weight is tied to milestones covering treasury activity, 24/7 fund operations and production volume.

articles.title: Bitrue to List Canton’s $CC Token for Spot Trading
articles.description: Bitrue will list Canton’s $CC token, with CC/USDT spot trading opening on August 4 and withdrawals becoming available the following day.

articles.title: Canton Network July 2026 Recap: Live Market Activity, Network Growth and New Products
articles.description: July brought live institutional transactions, new investment, stronger network figures, product launches and wider access to Canton Coin across the growing global Canton Network ecosystem.

articles.title: Temple Lists Ember’s Physically Backed Gold and Silver Tokens on Canton
articles.description: Temple Digital Group has listed Ember Protocol’s eXAU and eXAG for spot trading on Canton. Each token represents one troy ounce of fully allocated LBMA Good Delivery bullion held in professional vault custody.

articles.title: Chainalysis Explains Canton’s Privacy Model for Institutional Compliance
articles.description: Chainalysis has identified Canton as the main example of sub-transaction privacy, where data is shared only with relevant parties while authorised stakeholders can receive access when needed.

articles.title: The Biggest In-Person Canton Network Hackathon of 2026 Comes to London
articles.description: Cantor8 will bring university teams, developers and founders together on August 29 for a full day of building with Daml.

articles.title: Digital Asset Appoints Sylvain Bigaud as Senior Director of Global Business Development
articles.description: Digital Asset has hired Sylvain Bigaud, formerly Regional Head of Middle East, Africa, and Turkey at Euroclear, as Senior Director of Global Business Development and Strategy, based in Dubai.

articles.title: Arqitech Deploys Canton Token Standard V2 for Institutional Cross-Chain Swaps
articles.description: Arqitech has completed live institutional atomic swaps using Canton Token Standard V2, linking Canton Coin with assets on Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and TRON without bridges or third-party custody.

articles.title: SBI Rebrands Subsidiary to Build Financial Infrastructure on Canton Network
articles.description: SBI Holdings has renamed SBI Security Solutions as SBI Digital Practice and reorganised the wholly owned subsidiary around Canton Network. The company will develop financial infrastructure and support institutional implementation in Japan and overseas.

articles.title: Canton Strategic Holdings Elects Three New Directors as It Advances Canton Network Strategy
articles.description: Canton Strategic Holdings has elected Sean Galvin, Pamela L. Carter, and Rishi Nangalia to its Board of Directors, strengthening governance as the NASDAQ-listed company continues to build its Canton Coin-focused treasury and operating strategy.

articles.title: BitSafe Launches Decentralization Manager for Canton Network, Backed by $1 Million Foundation Grant
articles.description: BitSafe has launched Decentralization Manager in public beta, an open-source framework for distributed trust and custody infrastructure on Canton Network, backed by a $1 million Canton Foundation grant and already deployed by Palladium Labs, Nethermind, DSRV, and Finoa Consensus Services.

articles.title: Console Ecosystem Locks 50 Million CC Under CIP-0116 Featured App Requirements
articles.description: The Console ecosystem has locked more than 50 million CC across its four products under CIP-0116, reflecting a continued capital commitment to building practical infrastructure on Canton Network.

articles.title: State of the Canton Network H1 2026: Key Findings from Palladium Labs
articles.description: Palladium Labs’ 51-page State of the Canton Network – H1 2026 report maps the network’s growth across infrastructure, applications and institutional deployments, including more than 490 ecosystem participants and $9 trillion in monthly volume.

articles.title: Digital Asset Raises Additional $10 Million From Shinhan Financial Group and SC Ventures, Bringing Round to $365 Million
articles.description: Digital Asset has raised an additional $10 million from Shinhan Financial Group and SC Ventures, extending its funding round to $365 million at a $2 billion valuation.

articles.title: Nasdaq Pilots Tokenized Collateral on Canton Network as Q2 Earnings Hit Record Highs
articles.description: Nasdaq disclosed a successful Canton Network tokenized collateral pilot through its Calypso platform during a record Q2 2026 earnings call, as the exchange operator reported $1.5 billion in net revenue, $1 trillion in index AUM, and the largest IPO in history.

articles.title: Canton Strategic Holdings Sells Gravitas to Focus on Canton Network
articles.description: Canton Strategic Holdings has sold its biotech R&D arm, Gravitas Life Sciences, to Gravitas Collective Corp. The board-approved deal closed on July 17 as the Nasdaq-listed company narrows its operating strategy around the Canton Network.

articles.title: Hydra X Launches HX Gateway API to Speed Canton Deployments
articles.description: Hydra X has launched the HX Gateway API, a REST layer for institutions and developers building on Canton without specialised Daml expertise. The company says it can speed go-to-market by up to 80% and cut deployment time by 50%.

articles.title: From DTCC to Corporate Treasury: Yuval Rooz Outlines Canton’s Next Phase
articles.description: Digital Asset co-founder and CEO Yuval Rooz discusses DTCC’s first production activity, Canton mainnet extensions, network burn economics and a corporate treasury use case that could bring hundreds or thousands of businesses on-chain.

articles.title: Digital Asset Adds Shinhan and Standard Chartered to Funding Round
articles.description: Digital Asset has added Shinhan Financial Group and SC Ventures by Standard Chartered to its previously announced oversubscribed funding round, expanding its institutional investor base.

articles.title: OneSwap v2 Is Live on Canton
articles.description: OneSwap v2 is now live with a rebuilt swap engine, single-transaction swaps, a built-in platform wallet, and prepaid gas support for lower network fees.

articles.title: Ekiden Joins Canton Network as a Featured App
articles.description: Ekiden has been approved as a Featured App on the Canton Network. The project is building institutional derivatives infrastructure on Canton, with a hybrid RFQ and CLOB model for efficient on-chain market execution.

articles.title: Premia Acquires Raven Market in All-Cash Deal, Absorbing Canton-Native Derivatives Infrastructure
articles.description: Premia has acquired Raven Market in an all-cash deal, integrating the Canton-native institutional derivatives platform into its offering for 38 institutional clients managing more than $127 million in assets under management.

articles.title: Canton Network Has Burned 4.3 Billion Canton Coin Since Launch
articles.description: Canton Network has burned 4.3 billion CC since mid-2024, worth more than $500 million, with daily burns accelerating and a CIP draft expected in September that would extend burning to every synchronizer on the network.

articles.title: Visa Stablecoin Platform Launch Adds Weight to Canton Network's Institutional Momentum
articles.description: Visa has launched the Visa Stablecoin Platform for institutional stablecoin issuance and management, extending a year of stablecoin infrastructure development that includes becoming a Canton Network Super Validator and testing private stablecoin settlement on the network.

articles.title: Canton Network Q2 2026: A Deep Dive Into Transactions, Apps and Validators
articles.description: Canton Strategic Holdings' Q2 report says Canton Network averaged 2.28 million daily transactions, Featured Apps increased from 47 to 107, and approximately 200 new Validators launched. This deep dive examines the reported activity, institutional transactions, application growth, governance changes and data qualifications behind those figures.

articles.title: Canton Strategic Releases Q2 2026 Canton Network Ecosystem Report
articles.description: Canton Strategic Holdings released its second-quarter Canton Network ecosystem report, covering governance developments, institutional adoption and application-layer expansion. A public webinar will be held on July 22.

articles.title: Agentic Trading Infrastructure on Canton Network
articles.description: Silvana is an agent interaction layer for tokenized assets on Canton Network, providing an orderbook, developer tools, and infrastructure for automated trading workflows. The platform supports four trading pairs, more than 100 deployed agents, and over 3,000 onboarded traders, alongside an ongoing campaign with Edel Finance.

articles.title: Cashen Passes 50 Platforms as Canton Network's Credit Marketplace Gains Traction
articles.description: Cashen, the bilateral CC delegation marketplace backed by Cumberland DRW company Ergonia, has passed 50 platforms onboarded, cementing its position as one of the fastest growing startups on Canton Network by dollar value and the leading destination for locking CC under CIP-0116.

articles.title: Hanwha Invests KRW 30 Billion in Digital Asset Holdings, Plans Canton Network Participation
articles.description: Hanwha Investment & Securities has completed an approximately KRW 30 billion strategic investment in Digital Asset Holdings LLC and plans to participate in the Canton Network ecosystem.

articles.title: DTCC Says DTC-Held Asset Conversions Occurred on Canton and Hyperledger Besu
articles.description: DTCC says assets held at DTC were converted into tokens used in real production trades. The digital conversions occurred on Canton, a public network, and Hyperledger Besu, DTCC’s private network.

articles.title: Temple Digital Group Executes Onchain US Treasury Repo Trade on Canton Network via DTCC Tokenization Service
articles.description: Temple Digital Group participated in one of the first onchain US Treasury repo trades on Canton Network through DTCC's Tokenization Service, settling a tokenized Treasury against Circle's USDCx with atomic delivery-versus-payment, ahead of the service's expected October 2026 launch.

articles.title: Canton Network Powers Part of DTCC's Multi-Chain Tokenization Push, Balchunas Says
articles.description: Bloomberg ETF analyst Eric Balchunas confirmed the Canton public chain is being used in DTCC's latest tokenization project, alongside Hyperledger Besu, as part of a multi-chain strategy involving more than 40 firms including BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, and JPMorgan.

articles.title: Temple Digital Group and BitGo Partner to Bring Qualified Custody to Tokenized Assets on Canton Network
articles.description: Temple Digital Group and BitGo have partnered to bring regulated custody through BitGo Bank and Trust to tokenized assets on Canton Network, giving institutional clients access to capital markets through Temple alongside a qualified custody solution they can trust.

articles.title: Digital Asset / Canton Joins 54-Firm UK Wholesale Tokenisation Taskforce
articles.description: Digital Asset / Canton is among 54 firms supporting a UK programme to move wholesale-market tokenisation beyond pilots and into live markets. The taskforce will begin with tokenised repo and establish nine Action Groups over the next 12 months.

articles.title: Edel Finance Prepares Canton-Native Perpetuals Venue for Tokenized Assets
articles.description: Edel Markets is expected to launch later this quarter as a Canton-native perpetuals venue for tokenized equities, commodities and future multi-asset markets. Its design combines private positions, order-book execution, API access and onchain settlement.

articles.title: Grayscale Names Canton Among Five Networks Positioned for Tokenized Equities
articles.description: Grayscale says Canton Network is positioned to benefit as equity tokenization moves into regulated market infrastructure. Ethereum, Solana, BNB Chain and Avalanche could capture other parts of the market as three ownership models develop.

articles.title: Digital Asset Co-Founder Outlines Plan to Extend CC Burning to Every Canton Synchronizer
articles.description: Digital Asset co-founder Shaul Kfir has outlined plans to extend CC burning and validator rewards to all Canton synchronizers, with a CIP draft due in September and rollout targeted for the first half of 2027.

articles.title: OKJ to Add Canton Coin (CC) on July 15
articles.description: OKJ will begin supporting Canton Coin (CC) on July 15, 2026. Exchange trading, brokerage purchases, recurring purchases, deposits and withdrawals will be available.

articles.title: x402 Payments Go Live on Canton Network
articles.description: FTP Tech has brought x402 payments to Canton Network, enabling APIs to charge per request and settle payments on-ledger in Canton Coin.

articles.title: Turnkey Brings Secure Key Management and Signing Infrastructure to Canton Network
articles.description: Turnkey now supports Canton Network, providing developers with enclave-backed key management, Party registration, and transaction signing through a single API, removing the need to build custom signing infrastructure for Canton applications.

articles.title: NETSTARS and Canton Foundation Sign MOU to Explore Web3 Payments
articles.description: NETSTARS and Canton Foundation have signed an MOU to explore Web3-based payment solutions, including stablecoin payments, with privacy, interoperability and compliance as core priorities.

articles.title: Seven Days to Go: DTCC's Tokenization Service Prepares for Live Trading on Canton Network
articles.description: DTCC will launch its tokenization service on the Canton Network on July 13, enabling the first live blockchain trading of DTC-custodied U.S. Treasury securities. The rollout marks a major step in bringing traditional financial assets on-chain, with a full launch planned for October 2026.

articles.title: Tradeweb Facilitates Landmark On-Chain U.S. Treasuries Transaction on the Canton Network
articles.description: Tradeweb, Franklin Templeton, Virtu Financial, Digital Asset, Societe Generale, and Blockdaemon completed a real-time on-chain U.S. Treasury-for-cash trade settled via the Canton Network, marking a milestone for tokenized real-world assets and 24/7 market infrastructure.

articles.title: Temple: The Trading Engine at the Heart of Canton
articles.description: Canton is building the rails for tokenized finance. Temple is building Private and compliant financial market infrastructure for the world's institutions on the Canton Network.

articles.title: Canton Foundation to Sponsor WebX2026 in Tokyo as Platinum Partner
articles.description: The Canton Foundation has been confirmed as a platinum sponsor of WebX2026 in Tokyo on July 13 and 14, marking a direct push to engage Japanese and Asian institutional markets around Canton Network's blockchain infrastructure.

articles.title: Nexode Launches on Canton With USDCx Trader Rewards
articles.description: Nexode Prediction Market is live on Canton Network with a $5 USDCx welcome reward and a weekly $100 USDCx leaderboard pool.

articles.title: Walley Adds USDCx Bridge and In-App Swaps for Canton Users
articles.description: The K2F Labs self-custody wallet now provides direct access to the USDCx Bridge and supported token swaps within a single Canton interface.

articles.title: TermPrime Goes Live on Canton With Fixed-Rate Institutional Financing
articles.description: Term Structure Labs has launched a permissioned fixed-rate financing venue on Canton Network after completing an early seven-day transaction using CBTC collateral and Canton Coin.

articles.title: Canborsa Expands Asset List and Boosts Leverage as DEX Exits Beta
articles.description: Canborsa has exited beta with an expanded tokenized equity list including Microsoft, Meta, Alphabet, and Amazon, leverage increased to 30x, and a restructured points programme rewarding trading volume directly.

articles.title: Canton Network Goes Live With Logical Synchronizer Upgrades
articles.description: Canton Network has launched Logical Synchronizer Upgrades on Mainnet with Canton 3.5, introducing parallel synchronizer infrastructure, automatic validator switchover, preserved historical data, and smoother protocol upgrades.

articles.title: IntellectEU Launches CatalyX Package Manager 2.1 for Canton Network
articles.description: IntellectEU has launched CatalyX Package Manager 2.1, adding private distribution, access control, and flexible hosting options to its Daml package management platform for Canton Network participants.

articles.title: Noves and RedStone Partner to Bring Institutional Price Feeds to Canton Network
articles.description: Noves and RedStone have partnered to bring stablecoin and tokenized fund price feeds into the Noves Data Platform on Canton Network, supporting institutional mark-to-market valuation and reporting while preserving Canton's privacy model.

articles.title: Canton Network Leads All Blockchains in 30-Day Revenue
articles.description: Canton Network has recorded $59.91 million in 30-day revenue according to DeFiLlama data, ranking it among the top revenue-generating blockchain protocols globally and ahead of Tron and Ethereum by a substantial margin.

articles.title: Canton Weekly Roundup: Funding Rails, Wallets, RWA Updates and $CC Locking
articles.description: Canton Network saw movement across USD funding, exchange access, RWA infrastructure, wallets, $CC locking, liquidity, builder funding and app upgrades.

articles.title: OneSwap Wallet Is Live on Canton
articles.description: OneSwap Wallet brings self-custody, local signing, Google-backed recovery, token transfers, swaps, incoming offers, and balance tools to Canton users.

articles.title: CIP-0116: Canton’s Shift From Incentives to Accountability
articles.description: Weeks after CIP-0116 was approved, Canton projects are locking CC to maintain Featured App status, showing how the rule is turning commitment into action.

articles.title: SK Securities to Leverage Cantor8 and Canton Through Edena MOU
articles.description: SK Securities has signed an MOU with Edena Korea to expand its digital asset finance business, with the collaboration set to leverage Cantor8 and Canton Network infrastructure for RWA tokenization and STO-focused initiatives.

articles.title: T-RIZE Adopts Chainlink for Onchain Proof of Insurance on Canton
articles.description: T-RIZE has integrated Chainlink into its Kairos Digital Loan Notes programme, giving authorized participants a way to verify insurance coverage data for tokenized private-credit assets on Canton Network.

articles.title: Zenith Invited to Japanese Megabank Consortium to Tokenize $1.6 Trillion JGB Repo Market on Canton Network
articles.description: Zenith has joined Progmat’s Tokenized JGB / On-chain Repo Working Group, a DCC initiative studying tokenized Japanese Government Bonds, stablecoin cash legs, and on-chain repo settlement.

articles.title: Temple and HIFI Bring USD Funding and Settlement to Canton
articles.description: Temple Digital Group is partnering with HIFI to let eligible customers fund Canton wallets from bank accounts, convert USD into USDCx, trade on Temple, and withdraw through HIFI-supported banks.

articles.title: Moonsong Labs Joins Canton Ecosystem as Deployment Partner
articles.description: Moonsong Labs has joined the Canton Network ecosystem as a Service Provider and released a free Canton Readiness Guide. Its Canton practice supports institutions with Daml development, node setup, compliant asset workflows, and Global Synchronizer integration.

articles.title: Canton Strategic Launches Locking Service for Canton Coin Commitments
articles.description: Canton Strategic Holdings is introducing a locking-as-a-service offering for Canton Network app builders and Super Validators. The service follows CIP-0105 and CIP-0116, helping participants meet Canton Coin commitment requirements while managing capital more efficiently.

articles.title: Palladium Labs Launches 10 Million CC Genesis Fund to Support Canton Network Builders
articles.description: Palladium Labs has launched the Genesis Fund, a 10 million CC grant program worth approximately $1.5 million, to support builders developing financial applications, infrastructure, and tooling on the Canton Network.

articles.title: HECTO Now Available for Trading on Cantex
articles.description: HECTO, the utility token of Hecto Finance, is now live for trading on Cantex, expanding access to a Canton-native asset focused on prediction markets, tokenized private equity exposure and compliance-first private market infrastructure.

articles.title: Bithumb Lists Canton Coin ($CC) on Korean Won Market
articles.description: Bithumb has listed Canton Coin ($CC) on its KRW market, expanding the token’s presence in one of the world’s most active crypto markets.

articles.title: T-RIZE Locks 30M $CC Across Two Canton Featured Apps Under CIP-0116
articles.description: T-RIZE has locked 30,000,000 $CC across two Canton Network Featured Apps under CIP-0116, funding positions in tokenization, risk analytics and decentralized ML/FL.

articles.title: Rapid Chain Aims to Bridge EVM Liquidity and Canton Infrastructure
articles.description: Rapid Chain is building an EVM-compatible execution layer on Canton Network, pairing familiar wallets, Solidity tooling and cross-chain liquidity with Canton’s validation and settlement infrastructure.

articles.title: Canton Weekly Roundup: Repo, Token Standards, Featured App Lockups and New Consumer Rails
articles.description: Canton’s week brought movement across institutional markets, protocol upgrades, wallets, DeFi, Featured App economics and consumer-facing applications. The biggest updates covered onchain repo, new token standards, $CC lockups, embedded swaps, bridge activity and growing institutional interest.

articles.title: Yuval Rooz Says Tokenization’s Next Phase Is Coordinated Markets
articles.description: At NGDA 2026 in Seoul, Digital Asset CEO Yuval Rooz said tokenization must move beyond asset issuance toward coordinated financial infrastructure, with Canton positioned as a network-of-networks model for institutional markets.

articles.title: Grayscale Names Canton Network Among Top Beneficiaries if CLARITY Act Passes
articles.description: Grayscale has named Canton Network among four blockchains most likely to attract institutional capital if the CLARITY Act passes, citing regulatory certainty as the key unlock for institutional digital asset activity.

articles.title: T-RIZE Appoints Omar C. Bermudez as Product Director
articles.description: T-RIZE Group Corporation has named Omar C. Bermudez as Product Director, tasking the former McKinsey digital product lead with building out the company's product function across its tokenization and decentralized risk modelling infrastructure.

articles.title: CIP-0119: Free Canton Coin Transfer-Preapproval Base Duration
articles.description: CIP-0119 gives transfer preapprovals a free 90-day base duration, solving the bootstrapping problem where new participants needed CC to set up preapprovals before they could receive CC from exchanges. Preapprovals beyond 90 days still carry fees to protect Super Validator nodes.

articles.title: Canton Strategic is Expected to Join the Russell 3000 and Russell 2000 Indexes
articles.description: Canton Strategic Holdings said it is expected to be added to the Russell 3000 and Russell 2000 indexes after the latest Russell reconstitution, effective after market close on June 26, 2026.

articles.title: HIFI, DRW, and Marex Advance Onchain Repo on the Canton Network
articles.description: HIFI, DRW and Marex completed an onchain repo transaction on the Canton Network using familiar institutional plumbing: Tradeweb RFQ execution, prime brokerage intermediation and U.S. Treasuries as collateral. The significance is not that repo touched blockchain. It is that blockchain was used without abandoning the market structure institutions already rely on.

articles.title: Hecto's Allocator Crosses 17,000 Daily Users, Emerging as a Breakout Consumer Application on Canton
articles.description: Hecto’s Allocator has become one of Canton’s most active consumer apps, with 17,000+ daily users, 2.74M+ $CC distributed, and 18,000+ $HECTO holders. Built natively on Canton, the Allocator gives users a daily, non-liquidating way to engage with major private companies like OpenAI, SpaceX, Anthropic, ByteDance, Stripe, and Databricks. It is the first live stage of Hecto’s wider plan to bring signal, access, and settlement to the pre-IPO economy.

articles.title: Canton Strategic Holdings Authorizes $50 Million Share Repurchase Program
articles.description: Canton Strategic Holdings said its Board of Directors has authorized a share repurchase program allowing the company to repurchase up to $50 million of its common stock.

articles.title: HANDL Lists on OneSwap as HandlPay Becomes First Payments App to Integrate the SDK
articles.description: HANDL is now live on OneSwap and HandlPay has integrated the OneSwap SDK, making it the first payments application on Canton Network to embed native swap functionality.

articles.title: HandlPay Adds $USDC to Its In-App Bridge, Connecting Base & Polygon to Canton Network
articles.description: HandlPay has added USDC support to its in-app bridge, allowing users to move stablecoins between Base, Polygon, and Canton Network directly inside the HandlPay app

articles.title: a16z Opens Seoul Office With Crypto as First Priority for Asia Expansion
articles.description: Andreessen Horowitz has opened a Seoul office and named South Korea its Asian strategic base, with crypto as the first priority, following its $100 million participation in the Digital Asset Holdings round backing Canton Network.

articles.title: Ekiden Launches on Canton Testnet as Network's First CLOB-Based Derivatives Exchange
articles.description: Ekiden has launched on Canton Network's testnet as the first CLOB-based derivatives exchange on the network, with several trading firms already integrated and mainnet to follow.

articles.title: OneSwap Goes Live Inside Loop Wallet as First SDK Integration
articles.description: OneSwap is now live inside Loop Wallet, marking the first wallet integration of the OneSwap SDK and allowing Loop users to swap Canton assets natively without leaving the wallet.

articles.title: CIP-0112 Approved: Canton Network Upgrades Its Core Token Standard
articles.description: Canton Network has approved CIP-0112, upgrading its core token standard with privacy-enhanced batch settlement, traditional custody chain support, and committed allocations for prefunded trading, while maintaining full backwards compatibility with V1.

articles.title: Canton Network Welcomes 20 New Validator Operators, Including Citadel and Taishin Bank
articles.description: Canton Network has welcomed 20 new validator operators, with Citadel LLC and Taishin Bank among the most prominent names joining the network's growing institutional infrastructure base.

articles.title: Temple Accounts for Nearly a Third of Canton Network's Daily Fee Burn
articles.description: Temple Digital Group's order book generated 31.5% of Canton Network's total daily fee burn on June 11, 2026, making it the largest single contributor to network fee activity on that date.

articles.title: Kraken Adds USDCx Deposits and Withdrawals on Canton Network
articles.description: Kraken has enabled USDCx deposits and withdrawals on Canton Network, with spot trading to follow once liquidity thresholds are reached, as the exchange signals broader Canton ecosystem support ahead.

articles.title: Canborsa Launches Beta as First Perpetual RWA DEX on Canton Network
articles.description: Canborsa has launched in beta as the first perpetual RWA DEX on Canton Network, offering trading in tokenized stocks, gold, oil, and crypto with up to 20x leverage through a non-custodial interface.

articles.title: a16z Crypto Leads $355 Million Round in Digital Asset as Canton Network Draws Broad Institutional Backing
articles.description: Digital Asset has closed a $355 million round led by a16z crypto, with backing from more than a dozen financial institutions across TradFi and DeFi, as the Canton Network continues to build institutional momentum across tokenized asset markets.

articles.title: Send Launches Browser Extension to Connect Users to Canton Network Applications
articles.description: Send has launched Send Connect, a Chrome browser extension that brings a native wallet experience to Canton Network, allowing users to connect to applications, approve transactions with passkeys, and interact with the ecosystem directly from their browser.

articles.title: EDELx Lists on OneSwap as Edel Finance Becomes Latest Canton App to Embed the Protocol
articles.description: EDELx is now live on OneSwap, and Edel Finance has integrated the OneSwap SDK into its platform, making it the latest Canton application to embed permissionless swap functionality natively.

articles.title: Hacken Becomes Official Auditing Provider for Canton Network
articles.description: Hacken has been named an official auditing provider for Canton Network, with dedicated Daml certification and published security research supporting its role in reviewing smart contracts and infrastructure for institutional Canton applications.

articles.title: PartyLayer Integrates WalletConnect to Expand Canton Wallet Connectivity
articles.description: PartyLayer has integrated WalletConnect into its open-source wallet connectivity and developer experience layer for Canton dApps, giving developers an additional connection path alongside its existing multi-wallet support, CIP-0103-aligned interface, React tooling, and registry-based wallet discovery.

articles.title: CIP-0117 Approved: Canton Network Eliminates Multi-Hour Downtime for Protocol Upgrades
articles.description: Canton Network has approved CIP-0117, replacing multi-hour coordinated protocol upgrade halts with Logical Synchronizers that cut switchover downtime to seconds, with MainNet upgrade scheduled for June 27.

articles.title: Grayscale Files S-1 for Canton Coin ETF
articles.description: Grayscale has filed a Form S-1 with the SEC for the Grayscale Canton ETF, a proposed exchange-traded product designed to provide exposure to Canton Coin.

articles.title: Noves Launches Public Data Studio for Canton Network
articles.description: Noves has launched a public Data Studio for Canton Network, providing unified visibility into network activity, app economics, compliance data, and validator flows.

articles.title: Canton Network Welcomes 16 New Validator Operators
articles.description: Canton Network has welcomed 16 new validator operators, including Nipro, Silverlake, and Chainbase among the more established names joining its growing institutional infrastructure base.

articles.title: KB Securities Signs MOU With Canton Foundation And Wavebridge To Build Distributed-Ledger-Based Digital Asset Infrastructure
articles.description: KB Securities said it signed an MOU with the Canton Foundation and Wavebridge to jointly review distributed ledger-based infrastructure for domestic capital market transactions using the Canton Network.

articles.title: Visa and Brale Explore Private Stablecoin Settlement on Canton
articles.description: Visa is working with Brale on a proof of concept using SBC, a U.S. dollar-backed stablecoin issued by Brale, to evaluate privacy-enabled settlement for institutional payment flows on the Canton Network.

articles.title: Shinhan Financial Group Signs Canton Network MOUs to Bring Korean Assets to Global Investors
articles.description: Shinhan Asset Management and Shinhan Investment & Securities have each signed MOUs with Canton Foundation, aiming to use Canton Network's global institutional infrastructure to distribute Korean tokenized financial products to overseas investors.

articles.title: Mastercard Includes Canton in Stablecoin Settlement Expansion
articles.description: Mastercard has listed Canton among the blockchain networks expected to support regulated stablecoin settlement as it expands card-network settlement options across fiat, intraday, weekend, holiday and on-chain rails.

articles.title: EQ Market Launches on Testnet, Bringing Native Credit Markets to Canton Network
articles.description: EQ Market has launched on testnet with a CC and USDCx supply-and-borrow market, marking the first public release of a native lending protocol on Canton Network ahead of a planned mainnet launch.

articles.title: Canborsa Opens Beta for RWA Perpetuals on Canton Network
articles.description: Canborsa has launched the beta of its Canton Network-based trading platform, offering a self-custodial wallet, onchain swaps, and perpetual trading for crypto and tokenized real-world assets.

articles.title: Edel Finance Plans Canton-Based Perpetual Futures Exchange
articles.description: Edel Finance plans to launch Edel Markets in Q3 2026, bringing on-chain perpetual futures for equities and commodities to Canton Network.

articles.title: How $CC Holders Can Put Their Tokens to Work Across DeFi
articles.description: Canton DeFi is starting to give CC holders more ways to use their capital. From lending and borrowing to staking, liquidity pools, vaults, trading and bridges, there are now several live routes for putting CC and related assets to work.

articles.title: Send Opens Base-to-Canton Bridge for SEND, USDC, cbBTC and frxUSD
articles.description: Selected Base assets can now bridge directly into Send App on Canton, giving users a path to bring SEND, USDC, cbBTC and frxUSD into Send Canton Wallet as wrapped .B assets.

articles.title: Canton Network Tops Global Protocol Rankings by Revenue With $63.9 Million in 30 Days
articles.description: Canton Network has topped DeFiLlama's global protocol rankings by 30-day revenue, generating $63.9 million as its 100% fee burn model returns the entirety of network activity to participants.

articles.title: Bitwise Launches Canton ETP on Deutsche Börse Xetra
articles.description: Bitwise has launched the Bitwise Canton ETP on Deutsche Börse Xetra, giving investors exchange-traded exposure to CC, the native token of Canton Network. The product is issued by Bitwise Europe GmbH in Germany and is fully backed by CC tokens held in cold storage.

articles.title: Gate Enables USDCx Deposits and Withdrawals on Canton Network, Adds $150,000 CC Incentive Campaign
articles.description: Gate has enabled USDCx deposits and withdrawals on Canton Network and launched a $150,000 CC incentive campaign spanning spot trading, deposit challenges, and fixed-term savings products.

articles.title: OneSwap Launches as Canton Network's First Permissionless DEX
articles.description: OneSwap, built by Draper Associates and Coinbase Ventures-backed Sats Terminal, has launched as a permissionless AMM on the Canton Network, opening CC, USDCx, and tokenized Bitcoin trading to retail users on institutional settlement infrastructure.

articles.title: JPMorgan's Kinexys Crosses $1.5 Trillion in Cumulative Volume
articles.description: JPMorgan's Kinexys blockchain has crossed $1.5 trillion in cumulative volume, while the bank pursues a tokenized Treasury fund and plans to bring JPM Coin to Canton Network for institutional deposit token settlements in 2026.

articles.title: Grayscale Names Canton Among Blockchains Poised to Benefit From Regulatory Clarity
articles.description: Grayscale’s latest Stack article puts Canton alongside Ethereum, Solana and BNB Chain as networks positioned to benefit if US digital asset rules become clearer. For Canton, the signal is especially important: its strongest use case is not retail speculation, but regulated tokenization, privacy and institutional onchain finance.

articles.title: Canton Network Approves CIP-0116, Introducing CC Locking Requirements for Featured App Status
articles.description: Canton Network has approved CIP-0116, requiring Featured App applicants to lock between 5 million and 25 million CC per PartyId to qualify for and maintain Featured App designation, replacing a Foundation-led process with on-chain, market-based criteria.

articles.title: Canton Network Welcomes 32 New Validator Operators
articles.description: Canton Network has welcomed 32 new validator operators, including CME Group and Kakao Bank, as the network's infrastructure base continues to grow.

articles.title: Digital Asset Appoints OCC Strategy Head Oberon Knapp as Global Head of Equities
articles.description: Digital Asset has named Oberon Knapp, formerly head of strategy at the Options Clearing Corporation, as its global head of equities, tasking him with leading institutional equity and derivatives market structure strategy on Canton Network.

articles.title: Certora Wins Canton Foundation Grant for Daml Analysis Tooling
articles.description: Certora has received a Canton Development Fund grant to build open-source tooling that helps developers and institutions analyze cross-package interactions in Daml applications before deployment.

articles.title: Bybit Adds USDCx Deposits on Canton Network
articles.description: Bybit has enabled USDCx deposits via Canton Network, with withdrawal support to follow once liquidity thresholds are reached.

articles.title: Cancore Goes Live, Opening Atomic Swaps Between Canton and Public Chains
articles.description: Cancore is now live for everyone, giving users a non-custodial way to swap assets between Canton Network and public blockchains through peer-to-peer atomic settlement.

articles.title: SBI Group Leads Strategic Investment in Temple Digital Group
articles.description: SBI Group has led a private funding round in Temple Digital Group, the top-ranked application on the Canton Network by revenue, as Temple prepares to list regulated markets and expand its institutional trading infrastructure in the second half of 2026.

articles.title: Alpend Launches ONE, a Programmable Dollar Asset for Canton DeFi
articles.description: Alpend has introduced ONE, a CC-backed debt instrument designed to bring dollar-targeted liquidity to Canton DeFi and expand the utility of Canton Coin as productive collateral.

articles.title: Canton Network Named to BeInCrypto Institutional 100 Blockchain Infrastructure Long List
articles.description: BeInCrypto included Canton Network among 15 blockchain infrastructure firms selected for its 2026 Institutional 100 “Best Blockchain Infrastructure” long list.

articles.title: Introducing the new Canton Network developer docs
articles.description: Canton Network consolidated developer documentation into one hub with role-based learning, open-source contributions, and AI-assisted tooling.

articles.title: Temple Crosses $100 Million in Trading Volume on Canton Network
articles.description: Temple, the first native trading platform built on Canton Network, has surpassed $100 million in cumulative trading volume, marking a significant milestone for institutional on-chain trading within the Canton ecosystem.

articles.title: Rho Labs Announces Rho Relay, Bringing Private Cross-Chain Settlement to the Canton Network
articles.description: Rho Labs has launched Rho Relay, giving EVM users a private, non-custodial route to access and trade Canton Coin through Canton-native cross-chain settlement.

articles.title: Canton Strategic Deepens Canton Network Bet After First-Quarter Buildout
articles.description: Canton Strategic ended the first quarter with 3.68 billion Canton Coin, $41.5 million in cash, Super Validator approval, and a strengthened capital base as it builds its public-market strategy around Canton Network infrastructure.

articles.title: IntellectEU Launches Canton Onboarding Package for DTCC Tokenization Participants
articles.description: IntellectEU has launched a Canton onboarding package for institutions in the DTCC Industry Working Group, covering node operations, wallet and custody integration, custom development, tokenomics advisory, and legacy system integration.

articles.title: Societe Generale to Scale Tokenized Finance on Canton
articles.description: Societe Generale is expanding its work on Canton Network, with plans for tokenized collateral, on-chain financing, repo activity, and the deployment of SG-FORGE’s USD and EUR CoinVertible stablecoins.

articles.title: BlockBooster Joins Canton Foundation With Focus on Tokenized Credit
articles.description: BlockBooster has joined the Canton Foundation, where it plans to contribute to governance, committee work, and ecosystem development focused on tokenized credit, fund tokenization, and real-world asset management standards.

articles.title: Cantor8 Plans Canton-Powered Mobile Money Pilot in Africa With Yiksi Limited
articles.description: Cantor8 has secured exclusive MOUs with Yiksi Limited to explore bringing M-PESA and EVC Plus onto blockchain rails through Canton Network.

articles.title: Zenith surpasses 500,000+ EVM transactions in internal test environment
articles.description: Zenith’s internal test environment has processed more than 500,000 EVM transactions through Canton Network, with a 100% success rate and 1.5-second average latency on an unoptimized stack. The update gives an early look at Zenith’s native EVM architecture for Canton ahead of public testnet access.

articles.title: T-RIZE Launches $50M Private Credit Programme on Canton Network
articles.description: T-RIZE Group has announced the Kairos Digital Loan Notes programme, opening with a $50 million tranche for eligible institutional and qualified investors. Built on Canton Network, the programme brings UK litigation-finance receivables into a governed digital issuance framework with controls for eligibility, transfers, compliance and lifecycle administration.

articles.title: Privket Launches Canton Network's First NFT Collection
articles.description: Privket’s Canton Penguin collection sold out on Canton Network, marking the chain’s first NFT drop and an early test of collectible activity on the network.

articles.title: Digital Asset Targets $2 Billion Valuation as a16z Crypto Moves to Lead $300 Million Round
articles.description: Digital Asset is seeking roughly $300 million in new funding at a $2 billion valuation, with a16z crypto expected to lead, as institutional demand for regulated blockchain infrastructure continues to draw significant capital.

articles.title: Canton Foundation’s Viv Diwakar Joins Bitcoin Seoul 2026 Speaker Lineup
articles.description: Canton Foundation Head Viv Diwakar is listed among the speakers for Bitcoin Seoul 2026, which will take place June 4–5 at FKI Tower in Seoul. The event’s agenda is expected to focus on on-chain finance, real-world assets, stablecoins and AI, giving Canton a relevant stage in one of Asia’s major blockchain gatherings.

articles.title: Canton Network Welcomes 33 New Validator Operators to Its Growing Infrastructure
articles.description: Canton Network has welcomed 33 new validator operators, broadening the infrastructure base that supports the network's security and institutional-grade operations.

articles.title: ACME Brings Lending to Canton as the Network Moves Beyond Settlement
articles.description: ACME Lend is bringing lending and borrowing markets to Canton Network, testing whether the network’s privacy-focused infrastructure can support a deeper onchain credit layer. The launch adds another core financial primitive to a network that is still building out its application depth.

articles.title: Kaiko Indices Named Benchmark Provider for 21Shares Canton ETF
articles.description: Kaiko Indices will provide the benchmark behind TCAN, the 21Shares Canton Network ETF listed on Nasdaq. The role adds an independent reference-rate layer to the fund and extends Kaiko’s existing work around $CC market data.

articles.title: 21Shares Launches First U.S. ETF Offering Exposure to Canton Coin on Nasdaq
articles.description: 21Shares has listed what it calls the first U.S. ETF offering exposure to Canton Coin on Nasdaq, with Goldman Sachs, Microsoft, and Deutsche Bank among the institutions participating in the network — though not endorsing the fund.

articles.title: Temple Listed on CoinMarketCap as Top Global Exchange for $CC
articles.description: Temple is now listed on CoinMarketCap, giving the Canton-native trading platform a clearer public market-data profile. The listing makes Temple easier for traders to find, compare and track, while showing the platform as the top global exchange for $CC by 24-hour notional volume during the cited window.

articles.title: Why Now Is the Time to Build on Canton Network
articles.description: Canton is moving away from passive validator rewards and toward application activity, shared tooling, and ecosystem development. For eligible Featured Apps, rewards are now tied more directly to usage, while grants remain selective. The direction is clear: Canton’s next phase depends on builders turning its infrastructure into useful financial applications.

articles.title: AMINA Becomes First Bank to Support Canton Coin Trading and Custody
articles.description: AMINA Bank has become the first regulated banking institution to offer custody and trading for Canton Coin, giving institutional clients and network participants a supervised entry point into Canton Network's growing capital markets infrastructure.

articles.title: CIP-0105 Sets Locking Framework for Canton Super Validators
articles.description: CIP-0105 introduces a voluntary locking framework for Canton Super Validators. The approved proposal links forward SV Weight to actively locked lifetime-earned Canton Coin rewards and sets rules for tiered weighting, unlock vesting, custody and enforcement.

articles.title: DTCC Sets July Target for Initial Tokenized Securities Trades
articles.description: DTCC plans to facilitate initial, limited production trades through DTC’s tokenization service in July 2026, with a broader launch planned for October. Digital Asset, identified by DTCC as creator of Canton Network, is among more than 50 firms in the industry working group. The update follows DTCC’s separate partnership with Digital Asset and Canton Network to tokenize a subset of DTC-custodied U.S. Treasuries on Canton.

articles.title: Kresus and Canton Network Move to Bridge the Institutional Blockchain Execution Gap
articles.description: Kresus and Canton Network have partnered to help financial institutions take blockchain projects from development into live deployment — starting with a tokenized asset platform for South Korea's Hanwha Investment & Securities.

articles.title: Northern Trust and LSEG Among 22 Applicants to Operate Canton Validators
articles.description: Canton Network’s latest validator operator batch includes Northern Trust, LSEG and a wider set of infrastructure and application-focused firms. The list shows validator interest extending from major financial institutions to smaller operators ahead of a May 6 approval deadline.

articles.title: DeFi’s Security Reckoning Makes Canton Network’s Guardrails Harder to Dismiss
articles.description: Digital Asset CEO Yuval Rooz says institutions need ways to keep bad actors away from the assets and systems they operate on-chain.

articles.title: Canton Ends Passive Validator Rewards as Incentives Shift Toward Usage
articles.description: Canton Network has ended liveness rewards for validators, moving its incentive model away from passive node operation and toward usage, application demand, and long-term alignment.

articles.title: OneSwap Publishes Mainnet Review Showing Full Reserve Alignment
articles.description: OneSwap says its active mainnet pools were fully aligned with the live ledger during a new operational review prepared for liquidity providers and institutional counterparties.

articles.title: Lattice Brings Canton’s First Neobank and Privacy-Focused Banking Rails Closer to Launch
articles.description: Lattice is preparing to launch a Canton-based neobank that combines private settlement, self-custody, card spending and always-on access to digital assets.

articles.title: Chainlink Integrates With Alpend and Raven Market as Canton’s Application Layer Takes Shape
articles.description: Alpend and Raven Market are adopting Chainlink Data Streams to support private credit markets and deterministic options settlement on Canton.

articles.title: A Look Inside the Applications Building on Canton Network
