articles.description: Canton Network is best known for institutional finance, but a growing app layer is forming around Canton Coin, spanning wallets, explorers, DeFi apps, payment tools, NFT products, analytics platforms and trading venues.

articles.title: Grayscale Says Canton Could Lead Early Institutional Phase of Tokenization
articles.description: Grayscale Research names Canton alongside Ethereum, Solana, Avalanche, BNB Chain and Chainlink as networks positioned to benefit from the shift of capital markets onchain.

articles.title: Global Settlement Network Brings GSX ID Compliance Layer to Canton as Validator
articles.description: Global Settlement Network has been approved as a Canton validator and Featured Application, deploying GSX ID to help institutions reuse compliance credentials across tokenized capital market workflows.

articles.title: Canton Protocol 3.5 Introduces Logical Synchronizers for No-Downtime Upgrades
articles.description: Canton is moving from Protocol 3.4 to 3.5, with Logical Synchronizers designed to let the network upgrade without pausing transaction processing.

articles.title: Tradeweb Cites Canton Network Validation Services as Q1 Digital-Asset Revenue Driver
articles.description: Tradeweb reported $617.8M in Q1 revenue, said Other revenue rose 56.2% year over year, and later disclosed $3.7M of Validator Revenue tied to Canton Network services in its SEC filing.

articles.title: Visa Adds Canton Network to Stablecoin Settlement Pilot as Run Rate Hits $7B
articles.description: Visa added Canton Network to its global stablecoin settlement pilot as the program expanded to nine blockchains and reached a $7B annualized settlement run rate, up 50% from the previous quarter.

articles.title: Tokenized Treasurys Top $10.8B as Institutional Interest Grows
articles.description: Tokenized Treasurys are on-chain representations of U.S. government debt instruments, classified as real-world assets, or RWAs.

articles.title: How TRM Labs and Canton Network Make Privacy and Compliance Complementary
articles.description: Privacy-first blockchains can support AML compliance. See how Canton Network and TRM Lab enable selective disclosure and risk-based monitoring.

articles.title: Canton Tops Chain Revenue Rankings, Ahead of Tron and Ethereum
articles.description: DefiLlama data showed Canton in first place on chain revenue, with Tron second and Ethereum third in the latest 24-hour rankings.

articles.title: WalletConnect is now live on Canton Network
articles.description: WalletConnect is now live on Canton Network, giving supported wallets, custodians, and apps a standard way to connect. The integration brings seamless access across institutional finance and DeFi.

articles.title: Cancore Genesis Phase 2 Goes Live on Canton
articles.description: Cancore Genesis Phase 2 is now live, bringing $CC and $CBTC trading, transfer history, network fees, and improved infrastructure.

articles.title: Canton Goes Live on SwissBorg, Expanding Fiat Access for $CC
articles.description: SwissBorg now supports Canton, allowing users to buy $CC with 11 fiat currencies through card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay.

articles.title: Bitwave Enables Invoice-Linked, On-Chain Payments via Canton Integration
articles.description: Bitwave has integrated with Canton Network to connect invoices, payments, and settlement into programmable on-chain workflows for enterprise finance teams.

articles.title: Bitget to List Canton Coin (CC) on April 24 With 2.79 Million CC in Rewards
articles.description: Bitget will list Canton (CC) on April 24, with Launchpool and CandyBomb campaigns offering users a combined 2.79 million CC in rewards.

articles.title: HQLAᵡ Announces Strategic Investments from Broadridge and Digital Asset to Support Next Growth Phase on Canton
articles.description: HQLAᵡ has secured strategic investments from Broadridge and Digital Asset to support its next phase of growth on Canton.

articles.title: Temple Lightspeed: A New Era For Trading On Canton
articles.description: Temple has introduced Lightspeed, a major upgrade to its trading infrastructure on Canton, capable of processing over 100,000 orders per second with sub-10ms matching.

articles.title: WalletConnect Adds Support for Canton Network
articles.description: WalletConnect has added support for Canton Network, enabling access to institutional-grade apps and tokenized real-world assets through its wallet connectivity network.

articles.title: HTX Opens $CC Spot Trading on April 22
articles.description: HTX has announced the launch of $CC spot trading on its platform, with the CC/USDT pair scheduled to go live at 10:00 UTC on April 22, 2026, expanding market access for Canton’s native asset.

articles.title: Canton (CC) Listed on LBank — CC/USDT Trading Goes Live April 22
articles.description: LBank, a leading global cryptocurrency exchange, has announced the listing of Canton (CC) on its platform, with CC/USDT spot trading scheduled to open on April 22, 2026 — further expanding CC's accessibility across global markets.

articles.title: Canton Strategic Holdings Publishes First Quarterly Canton Network Ecosystem Update
articles.description: Canton Strategic Holdings has published its Q1 2026 ecosystem report on Canton Network, outlining adoption milestones, transaction growth, and key infrastructure developments across the quarter.

articles.title: Mizuho, Nomura, JSCC and Digital Asset Bring JGB Collateral Pilot to Canton Network
articles.description: A new pilot on Canton Network will test how Japanese government bonds can support real-time, 24/7 collateral management across domestic and cross-border markets.

articles.title: Hanwha Investment & Securities Signs MOU with Blockchain Firm Digital Asset
articles.description: Hanwha Investment & Securities has signed an MOU with Digital Asset, the company behind Canton Network, to explore cooperation across different areas of finance.

articles.title: Northern Trust Integrates with Canton Network to Build Institutional Custody for Tokenized Assets
articles.description: Northern Trust is working with Digital Asset to develop custody capabilities for tokenized financial assets on Canton Network. The move extends its asset servicing model into digital market infrastructure.

articles.title: CC Consolidates Near $0.147 as Institutional Momentum Builds Beneath the Surface
articles.description: CC is holding near $0.147 while Canton’s institutional milestones continue to build. Recent HSBC, JPMorgan, and CredShields activity points to growing long-term network momentum.

articles.title: CredShields Joins Canton Network as Official Audit Partner
articles.description: CredShields has joined Canton Network as an official Audit Partner. The move brings smart-contract security expertise to infrastructure used by institutional finance.

articles.title: Canton Network Emerges as Focal Point at Paris Blockchain Week 2026
articles.description: Paris Blockchain Week highlighted privacy and composability as key barriers to institutional blockchain adoption. Canton Network was positioned as one of the projects addressing both.

articles.title: Upbit Announces Canton (CC) Listing on KRW, BTC, and USDT Markets
articles.description: South Korea's largest crypto exchange, Upbit, has announced the listing of Canton (CC) across its KRW, BTC, and USDT markets — a significant milestone for CC's accessibility in one of the world's most active crypto trading regions.

articles.title: Visa Expands Blockchain Infrastructure Footprint — With Canton Network Super Validator Role at the Core
articles.description: Visa’s new blockchain validator work adds to its broader institutional infrastructure strategy. Its Canton Network Super Validator commitment remains part of that footprint.

articles.title: Canton Network Executes World's First Private Stablecoin Payroll for a Global Enterprise
articles.description: Canton Network powered a private stablecoin payroll for a global enterprise. The milestone shows how institutional blockchain infrastructure can support real business payments.

articles.title: Inside Canton Network: The Infrastructure Layer Powering Institutional Finance
articles.description: Canton Network is already being used across institutional finance, from tokenized settlement to major partnerships. This overview explains how the network works and who is building on it.

articles.title: CC Holds Steady at $0.139–$0.147 as Institutional Momentum Builds
articles.description: CC has held a tight $0.139-$0.147 range as institutional momentum builds around Canton. The market is weighing a different kind of blockchain asset with an institution-first design.

articles.title: Stablecoins Set to Move $719 Trillion Through Global Payments — and Canton Network Is Already at the Center
articles.description: Visa, Mastercard, and Stripe are moving deeper into stablecoin settlement infrastructure. Canton Network is emerging as one institutional layer for payments, settlement, and treasury use cases.

articles.title: ClearToken Appoints Chief Risk Officer as Canton-Based Platforms Advance Toward Launch
articles.description: ClearToken has named Fernando Cerezetti as Chief Risk Officer of its CCP subsidiary — a high-profile appointment that signals the firm's accelerating push to deliver the first FMI-grade infrastructure for tokenized settlement on the Canton Network.

articles.title: Canton Network vs. Ethereum: Institutional Blockchain Reality or TradFi Detour?
articles.description: Canton’s growth in institutional settlement raises a bigger question for blockchain adoption: will financial markets favor open rails like Ethereum, or privacy-first networks like Canton?

articles.title: HSBC Completes First Tokenised Deposit Pilot on Canton Network
articles.description: HSBC has successfully completed a pilot simulating the issuance, transfer, and atomic settlement of its Tokenised Deposit Service (TDS) on the Canton Network — marking the first time the bank's TDS was issued and used on a public blockchain.

articles.title: JPMorgan Brings Deposit Token to Canton Network, Marking New Era for Institutional Finance
articles.description: JPMorgan Chase has announced plans to deploy its JPM deposit token on the Canton Network through its tokenization platform, Kinexys — a move that positions Canton as a cornerstone infrastructure for next-generation institutional finance.
